Checklist of Implementing Standards as at 30.06.2018

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by section 120 (1) of the Civil Aviation Act no. 14 of 2010, I, H.M.C. Nimalsiri,Director General of Civil Aviation do here by issue the checklist of Implementing Standards for the information of theaviation personnel.
H.M.C. NIMALSIRI,Director General of Civil Aviation &
